children: Public Investment Fund-backed ROSHN Group and Talaat Moustafa Group Saudi, part of Egypt's Talaat Moustafa Group (TMG) have signed a preliminary agreement to establish a joint venture to explore and develop a mixed-use project in Riyadh.
Talaat Moustafa Group Saudi will hold a 51 percent stake in the joint company, while ROSHN Group will hold a 49 percent stake, the companies said in a joint statement.
The agreement establishes a framework for the two companies to evaluate a potential partnership for the project's phased development.

The concept under evaluation is for a residential-led, mixed-use community supported by retail, commercial, hospitality, leisure, healthcare and education facilities, together with parks and public spaces.
ROSHN Group and TMG Saudi intend to undertake detailed master planning and develop the project's business case.
Preliminary studies suggest the project will comprise more than 55,000 residential units, the statement said.

title: ROSHN, TMG to explore mixed-use project in Riyadh
